author: Anna Laetitia Barbauld
title: Hymns in Prose for Children
edition: London: J. Johnson, 1781. University of Pennsylvania A Celebration of Women Writers transcription of the first edition. Historical spelling and displayed split words are retained. Paragraph line wrapping and HTML spacing are normalized; verse line and stanza boundaries are retained. Image-only initial letters are restored from their source alt text and joined to the following word. Page numbers, images, illustration captions, and publisher/digitizer matter are omitted. The library text holds the whole book as transcribed (the transcription’s copytext is the 1977 facsimile of the 1781 edition, with long s printed as s): the title from the title page as a level-1 heading, the author’s Preface signed A. L. B., and Hymns I–XII each under its printed heading at level 2, ending with THE END.; the transcriber’s editorial contents table and About This Edition note are omitted.

rights.basis: This original English edition was published in 1781, before 1931; its US publication copyright term has expired as of 2026. No modern introduction or illustrations are included.

acquisition.method: UPenn A Celebration of Women Writers HTML (hymns-in-prose.html) parsed with Python's html.parser: the site banner and catalogue heading, the title-page author and imprint lines, the editor-supplied contents table, the empty page-number markers and page-break comments, and the closing About This Edition note and editor credit dropped; the title-page title HYMNS IN PROSE FOR CHILDREN. kept as the level-1 heading. The Preface and each Hymn heading became level-2 headings and every HTML paragraph one paragraph block, with all whitespace runs (line wraps and the transcription’s double spaces after sentences) folded to single spaces; split words displayed across a page break (for example ten- der) kept as transcribed. Every Grade 3 night from this book was located block for block.
